_readme: Every product fact this pack's copy depends on, in one place, with the file on
the app's PRODUCTION branch it came from and the date it was checked.
── The rule this file exists to enforce ─────────────────────────────────────
COPY DESCRIBES origin/main ONLY. Not a development branch, not a feature
flagged off, not anything that has not shipped in an official APK. The app's
`development` branch is normally ahead of production by a store or a feature,
and marketing that reads the wrong branch ships a claim the app cannot honour.
That is not hypothetical. The 04-community pack shipped `TWO DOWN` and ticked
both Costco and Best Buy as live, sourced from a working tree that happened to
be on `development`. On origin/main, Best Buy is still in LAB_STORE_PARSERS,
which in a store build behaves as if the parser were not there at all.
Store rows are read by scenes/render.js and turned into the ticked list, so a
store's status is stated ONCE. verify.js gate 12 fails the build if a frame
names a store as live that is not live here.
When something changes in the app: update this file, re-render, and check the
frames it touched. Do not edit a checklist in strings.json by hand.

stores._source: src/services/receiptParsers/index.js — STORE_PARSERS and LAB_STORE_PARSERS; src/constants/stores.js — the enabled flag
_note: `live` means a DEDICATED receipt parser in a store build. Everything else
falls through to the generic parser, which reads a total but not the store's
own line-item layout — a different claim, and not one to make.
Detection is broader than support: receiptParsingShared.js recognises about
twenty retailers by name. Recognising a receipt is not reading it.

credits.startingGrantNote: A one-time lifetime grant, not a monthly reset. FREE_TIER_SCANS_PER_MONTH is 0.
credits.dropChargeNote: Charged when a verified drop is DETECTED, not when the claim is filed. Do not write 'charged on successful claims only' — the app's own tagline says that and the code does not.

referral.paysOn: the friend's first purchase — a credit pack or a subscription
notes: NOT on sign-up, and NOT on their first scan. The app's own invite screen says
'their first receipt scan unlocks the reward' and that string is wrong.
A free trial does not count until it converts.
The code is redeemable ONLY during sign-up, once per person, ever.
There is no deep link — the friend types the code. Do not write 'tap the link'.
No cap on how many people one person can invite.
Credit is DEFERRED until three distinct users independently observe the same
price. Only tags that show a saving are eligible.
One payout per product, per warehouse-or-province, per calendar week.
There is NO contributor tier, reputation, level or leaderboard. Caps are flat
for everyone — so 'the more you give the more you get' is true only in the
sense that contributions offset what you would otherwise spend.

subscription.name: Unlimited
subscription.annualNote: Annual is ten times the monthly price — twelve months for the price of ten.
subscription.priceRule: NEVER PRINT A PRICE. Not on art, not in a caption. claims.js bans currency figures and percentages, and the reason is in the pack notes: a printed price outlives the price it prints. The app README still says $12/mo, which has been wrong for months.

emailSync.gmailNote: gmailSyncEnabled is false on origin/main. gmail.readonly is a Google RESTRICTED scope and the OAuth verification has not started, so the app renders a 'Coming soon' card. DO NOT MENTION GMAIL.
privacyNote: The 'receipt data never leaves your device' guarantee is GMAIL-ONLY and Gmail
is not live. receiptSyncService.js:147 — 'Outlook receipts are Microsoft data
and keep syncing normally.' A frame claiming inbox data stays on the phone is
false for the provider that actually ships. 04-community story 17 said exactly
What IS true: the scope is read-only, we extract the receipt and not the
mailbox, and the app never sends mail.

shipped: automatic price watching over parsed receipt line items
two claim-deadline reminders — one early, one just before the window shuts
claim assistant: an email draft, or a script to read at the desk
offline scan queue that drains when signal returns
per-store launch notifications you can subscribe to
English and French throughout, enforced by a test
a savings streak, counted in weeks
notShipped: a currency setting — CAD is hardcoded
any credit or reward from badges or streaks; they are cosmetic and device-local
